thread:
Mira (design): Quick design review: suggestion to expose correlation IDs more prominently in the trace drilldown header so folks can copy/share quickly. Mock: https://figma.com/file/abc
Sana (eng-ux): Ditto. Idea: a small monospace 'corr' pill next to the service name. Click copies short link. On mobile pill becomes an icon that opens a popover with actions.
Ben (eng-runtime): Backend note: we should serve a short-link token instead of raw IDs for sharing. Export API should accept ?full=true for full frames.
Olivia (accessibility): Pill must be keyboard-focusable and have aria-label: "Copy trace link for request 2015554321". Icon-only variant needs 4.5:1 contrast and focus outline.
Arjun (support): If copy shows a toast with the short URL + 'Report issue' quick-link that prefills a ticket with the link and top 3 frames, that'll save us a ton of context chasing. Can be behind org toggle.
Sana (eng-ux): Popover layout proposal: row1 ID + copy, row2 primary 'Copy trace link', secondary 'Export JSON', small 'Report with context'. Keyboard: Tab to cycle, Esc to close.
Mira (design): Microcopy: prefer 'Copy trace link' (explicit). Toast text: 'Trace link copied. Open or share.' with an 'Open' button.
Ben (eng-runtime): For large traces export triggers a job -> returns export_job_id. UI should poll and update aria-live region: "Export ready" when done. Also include correlation_ids array in payload.
Olivia (accessibility): Also ensure focus is restored to the trigger after popover closes, and trap focus while open. Announce export progress updates with polite aria-live.
design-bot: Checklist: include color contrast screenshots and keyboard nav gif before merge.
Mira (design): Actions: Sana update mocks for desktop/mobile, Ben to confirm short-link endpoint & export job shape, Olivia to draft a11y checklist. Will reconvene after updates. :thumbsup:
